bank_name: AETS Part One 听力理解题库
schema_note: 每套题(set)含若干听力材料组(group)；每组一段对话(dialogue, P=飞行员 C=管制员)和1-4道题(questions)；answer 为正确选项字母；audio_* 为配套音频的规划路径（生成后按此命名）。
exam_note: 问题念完后5秒作答，听力只播放一遍（think_time_sec=5）。

paper_rules.说明: 组卷规则：不是150题混抽15题，而是分层随机。
paper_rules.q1_5: 从全部套卷的 slot=q1_5 组中（每套5组，共50组短对话，每组1题）完全随机抽5组，依次作为新卷 Q1-Q5。
paper_rules.q6_8: 从 slot=q6_8 的组中（共10组，每组含1段对话+3题）随机抽1组，整组作为 Q6-Q8，不可拆分；可与其他组来自不同套卷。
paper_rules.q9_12: 从 slot=q9_12 的组中（共10组，每组含1段对话+4题）随机抽1组，整组作为 Q9-Q12，不可拆分。
paper_rules.q13_15: 从 slot=q13_15 的组中（共10组，每组含1段对话+3题）随机抽1组，整组作为 Q13-Q15，不可拆分。

sets.title: AETS test simulation 9
sets.directions: In this part, you are going to hear a dialogue or exchange, after the exchange, there will be a question. After each question, you have 5 seconds to think and choose the correct answer. You will hear each question only once.

dialogue.speaker: P
dialogue.text: Apron, CHH7766, we have an APU fire at the stand, request fire service immediately, passengers are evacuating via the jet bridge.

dialogue.speaker: C
dialogue.text: CHH7766, Apron, roger, fire service is on the way.

questions.question: What happened to CHH7766?

options.C: An APU fire at the stand.

questions.explanation: 飞行员明确报告 'we have an APU fire at the stand'，即停机位上发生 APU（辅助动力装置）起火，故选 C。A 项 GPU（地面电源车）与 D 项发动机火均为干扰。

dialogue.speaker: C
dialogue.text: CSN6503, Wuhan Ground, expedite taxi via C and C1, cross RWY18, then via D and D5 to holding point of RWY36L.

dialogue.speaker: P
dialogue.text: Cross RWY18, via D and D5 to holding point RWY36L, CSN6503.

questions.question: Which runway will CSN6503 cross during taxi?
questions.explanation: 管制员指令 'cross RWY18, then via D and D5 to holding point of RWY36L'，滑行中须穿越的是 18 号跑道，RWY36L 只是滑行的终点等待点，故选 B。

dialogue.speaker: P
dialogue.text: PANPAN, PANPAN, PANPAN, Wuhan Approach, CCA2760, a five-year-old child has a high fever with convulsions, request priority landing and an ambulance.

dialogue.speaker: C
dialogue.text: CCA2760, Wuhan Approach, roger PANPAN, you are number one.

questions.question: Why is CCA2760 making an urgency call?

options.D: Because a passenger had a stroke.

questions.explanation: 飞行员宣布 PANPAN 时说明 'a five-year-old child has a high fever with convulsions'，即一名五岁儿童高烧并伴有抽搐，因此请求优先落地和救护车，故选 C。

dialogue.speaker: C
dialogue.text: CES5288, Wuhan Approach, turn left heading 270, descend to 2100m on QNH1008, cleared ILS approach RWY36R.

dialogue.speaker: P
dialogue.text: Turn right heading 270, descend to 2100m on QNH1008, cleared ILS approach RWY36R, CES5288.

dialogue.speaker: C
dialogue.text: CES5288, negative, turn LEFT heading 270.

questions.question: What did the controller correct in the readback?
questions.explanation: 飞行员把指令复诵成 'Turn right heading 270'，管制员纠正 'negative, turn LEFT heading 270'。航向 270 本身没错，被纠正的是转弯方向（左/右），故选 D。

dialogue.speaker: P
dialogue.text: Approach, CSN6102, we have traffic on TCAS at 6 o'clock, 4nm, 200m below us, climbing fast, confirm.

dialogue.speaker: C
dialogue.text: CSN6102, it's a military jet, maintain 4500m, we are working on it.

questions.question: Where is the military jet?
questions.explanation: 飞行员报告 'traffic on TCAS at 6 o'clock, 4nm, 200m below us, climbing fast'，管制员确认是军用机，与 B 项完全一致。A 项方位错（12 o'clock），C 项在上方且下降，D 项距离错（14nm）。

dialogue.speaker: P
dialogue.text: Tower, CCA1710, ready.

dialogue.speaker: C
dialogue.text: CCA1710, cleared for takeoff, RWY05L, surface wind 360 degrees 7m/s gusting to 15m/s, after airborne, contact Departure on 120.6.

dialogue.speaker: P
dialogue.text: Cleared for takeoff, Departure 120.6, CCA1710.

dialogue.speaker: P
dialogue.text: Tower, CCA1710, 150m climbing. We had a stick shaker during rotation, request return to land.

dialogue.speaker: C
dialogue.text: CCA1710, roger, turn right heading 090, descend to 900m, do you need any assistance?

dialogue.speaker: P
dialogue.text: Turn right heading 090, descend to 900m, request a long final and fire service on standby, CCA1710.

dialogue.speaker: C
dialogue.text: Roger, CCA1710, fire service will be on standby. Contact Approach 126.8.

dialogue.speaker: P
dialogue.text: Approach 126.8, thanks, CCA1710.

questions.question: What was the wind condition when CCA1710 took off?
questions.explanation: 起飞条件中管制员通报 'surface wind 360 degrees 7m/s gusting to 15m/s'，阵风达 15m/s，属于阵风（gusty wind）天气，故选 D。

questions.question: What happened to CCA1710 during takeoff?

options.A: It had a stick shaker during rotation.

questions.explanation: 飞行员升空后报告 'We had a stick shaker during rotation'，即抬轮时出现抖杆（失速警告），故选 A。对话未提及鸟击、起落架或发动机喘振。

questions.question: What assistance did the crew of CCA1710 request?

options.C: A long final and fire service on standby.

questions.explanation: 机组明确请求 'request a long final and fire service on standby'，即长五边进近并让消防部门待命，故选 C。

dialogue.speaker: C
dialogue.text: BAW631, Wuhan Control, due traffic, offset 4nm right of track, expect rejoin the route at TM.

dialogue.speaker: P
dialogue.text: Roger, offset 4nm right of track, BAW631.

dialogue.speaker: P
dialogue.text: Control, BAW631, we have weather indication 30nm ahead of us, request deviate to the left for 8nm.

dialogue.speaker: C
dialogue.text: BAW631, negative due to prohibited area, can you accept deviation to the right?

dialogue.speaker: P
dialogue.text: Affirm, we need a heading of 140 for 16nm, BAW631.

dialogue.speaker: C
dialogue.text: BAW631, turn right heading 140, report clear of weather.

dialogue.speaker: P
dialogue.text: Right heading 140, wilco, BAW631.

dialogue.speaker: P
dialogue.text: MAYDAY, MAYDAY, MAYDAY, Wuhan Control, BAW631, we have a galley fire, there is smoke in the cabin, we are emergency descending to 3600m.

dialogue.speaker: C
dialogue.text: BAW631, Wuhan Control, roger MAYDAY, report reaching. Break Break. All stations, Wuhan Control, emergency descent between TM and XS, all aircraft below 7500m, leave the route to the north.

questions.question: How did the pilot of BAW631 plan to avoid the weather?
questions.explanation: 飞行员发现天气后请求 'request deviate to the left for 8nm'，计划向左偏 8 海里绕飞，故选 B。heading 140 是左偏被否决后另行商定的方案，不是最初的计划。

questions.question: Why was the left deviation not approved?
questions.explanation: 管制员拒绝左偏时说明 'negative due to prohibited area'，即左侧有禁区，故选 A。受限区、军方活动和危险区均未提及。

questions.question: What happened to BAW631?

options.B: A galley fire with smoke in the cabin.

questions.explanation: 飞行员宣布 MAYDAY 时说 'we have a galley fire, there is smoke in the cabin'，即厨房起火且客舱有烟，故选 B。

questions.question: Where is BAW631 when it started emergency descent?
questions.explanation: 管制员向全体航空器广播 'emergency descent between TM and XS'，说明紧急下降发生在 TM 与 XS 之间；3600m 是飞行员报告的下降目标高度，7500m 则是要求其他飞机避让的高度界限，故选 A。

dialogue.speaker: P
dialogue.text: Wuhan Tower, CCA908, vacating RWY36.

dialogue.speaker: C
dialogue.text: CCA908, roger, taxi to stand 214 via B7.

dialogue.speaker: P
dialogue.text: Stand 214 via B7, CCA908.

dialogue.speaker: C
dialogue.text: CSN7701, go around, I say again, go around, there is a dog on the runway!

dialogue.speaker: P
dialogue.text: Going around, CSN7701.

dialogue.speaker: P
dialogue.text: Tower, CSN7701, how long will the delay be? We are getting close to minimum fuel.

dialogue.speaker: C
dialogue.text: CSN7701, expect approach in 10 minutes, the animal control team is on the way to remove the dog, contact Wuhan Approach on 119.4.

dialogue.speaker: P
dialogue.text: Approach 119.4, CSN7701.

questions.question: Why was CSN7701 instructed to go around?

options.A: There was a vehicle on the runway.
options.C: The preceding aircraft was slow to vacate.
options.D: There was an animal on the runway.

questions.explanation: 管制员指令复飞的原因是 'there is a dog on the runway'，跑道上有动物（狗），故选 D。前机未脱离是 CCA908 已正常脱离的干扰项，对话中未提及车辆或风切变。

questions.question: What will happen before CSN7701's next approach?

options.A: The animal control team will remove the animal.
options.B: The inspection vehicle will chase the dog away.
options.C: The runway will be closed for hours.

questions.explanation: 管制员告知 'the animal control team is on the way to remove the dog'，动物控制组正在赶来将狗带离跑道，之后再进近，故选 A。

questions.question: Why is CSN7701 concerned about the delay?

options.A: There is a sick passenger on board.
options.B: The crew is running out of duty time.
options.C: It is getting close to minimum fuel.

questions.explanation: 飞行员主动说明 'We are getting close to minimum fuel'，油量已接近最低标准，因此关心延误时间，故选 C。
